how_to_apply: The notice asks for an offline application in the prescribed format, which is printed with the notification. The notice does not describe an online form.
Take the application form for the post of Agriculture Assistant / Field Assistant printed at the end of the notification (Ref: No. SWCE/SLCL-DG/Notification/AA/FA/106/2026).

Fill in the form: post applied for, full name in block letters, father's/husband's name, gender, date of birth, age as on 11/12/2026, marital status, mobile number, email address, correspondence and permanent address with PIN code.
Fill in educational qualifications starting with SSC, work experience, present employment details and any additional information. Affix a passport size photo, then add the date and signature.
Enclose self-attested copies of the certificates and documentary evidence for the entries marked with an asterisk in the form.

Send the application by post, courier service or in person to: Principal Investigator, "Development of Relationship Between Sediment Loss and Carbon Loss From untreated part of Watershed of university and Daithane Gunjal", Department of Soil & Water Conservation Engineering, Dr. A.S. College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, MPKV, Rahuri, Dist: Ahillyanagar-413 722 (MS).
Email applications go to [email protected]. The notice gives no subject line.
Make sure the application reaches by 11 December 2026, up to 6.00 PM.

For queries on the application procedure, the notice names the Assistant Professor of the department, on cell phone 9404360795. Mobile number and email must be written correctly, because further correspondence will be by SMS/email only.
Self-attested true copies of the relevant certificates and documentary evidence.
Passport size photo on the application form.
Photo identity, to be produced during the "Verification of Document" process or the interview.
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form makes the candidate ineligible. If any information in the application is found false, the candidature or, if selected, the services may be terminated without notice. The appointee must execute a bond on bond paper of Rs. 100 stating that the terms and conditions are acceptable. The appointee is a full-time worker and may not do any other work or hold another appointment, with or without remuneration, during the period. The appointee has to work anywhere in the jurisdiction of MPKV as and when the need arises, and must follow the administrative, financial and disciplinary regulations of the university/institute. Attendance may be kept in an attendance register by the Co-PI/PI. The appointee performs all duties assigned by the Principal Investigator/Co-Principal Investigator as the project requires. The notice does not list the duties. Research work done belongs to the project and MPKV, Rahuri, which holds the intellectual property rights. The appointee's name may be acknowledged in a research paper at the sole decision of the PI. The appointee has no legal right to regularisation, absorption against a regular post or further contractual engagement, and must settle claims within one month.

content_sections.heading: About MPKV
content_sections.text: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth is based at Rahuri in Ahillyanagar district, Maharashtra, and the notice is issued on the letterhead of the Government of Maharashtra. This post sits in the Department of Soil & Water Conservation Engineering of Dr. A. S. College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, which runs the ad-hoc research project on sediment loss and carbon loss from the untreated part of the watershed of the university and Daithane Gunjal. The post is under the administrative control of the concerned Co-Principal Investigators (Co-PI) and the Principal Investigator (PI).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only one post is advertised. Each condition below applies to the Agriculture Assistant / Field Assistant post. Degree in Agriculture or Agricultural Engineering. Field experience of working in Watersheds will be preferred. Field experience in University/State/Central Govt. managed projects/schemes farms. Knowledge of Computer for use of Microsoft Office. The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The application form asks for the applicant's age as on 11 December 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 16,000 per month consolidated. The notice names no allowance on top of this amount. The position is available until the end of the project, but initially for a period of 6 months or till the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The post is purely temporary, time-bound and non-regular, on a contractual and co-terminus basis with the project. The engagement ends on completion of the project tenure or on the date stated in the appointment order, whichever is earlier, whether or not this is communicated individually. Either side may end the engagement by giving one month's notice. The project can also end the services by one month's notice without citing reasons. Services can be terminated at any time on 24 hours' notice for negligence, gross negligence, grave misconduct or indiscipline. Leaving the assignment without permission for one month means termination from the date of absence. An appointee who wants to leave mid-tenure must give one month's written notice in advance or remit one month's salary. On leaving, the appointee must hand over charge to a person nominated by the Principal Investigator and obtain a No Objection Certificate from the Principal Investigator.

College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, MPKV, Rahuri, Dist: Ahillyanagar-413 722 (MS). Email applications go to [email protected] . The notice gives no subject line. Make sure the application reaches by 11 December 2026, up to 6.00 PM. For queries on the application procedure, the notice names the Assistant Professor of the department, on cell phone 9404360795. Passport size photo on the application form. Photo identity, to be produced during the "Verification of Document" process or the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinised for eligibility, and only short-listed candidates are called for the interview. The selection committee interviews only eligible candidates. The interview date is communicated to eligible candidates separately by email/text message. The notice does not state the interview venue. Applicants appear for the interview on the scheduled date and time at their own cost. No additional documents are accepted separately before the last date, after the last date or at the time of interview. The notification does not mean that the post will necessarily be filled. The discretionary power rests with the Selection Committee.
